features.name: glucose_high_flag
features.description: Indicator that plasma glucose exceeds clinical impaired-glucose threshold (140 mg/dL).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a clean split point matching established glucose tolerance cutoff.

features.name: glucose_bucket
features.expected_model_benefit: Compact ordinal encoding of clinically meaningful glucose ranges for tree splits.

features.name: bmi_category
features.expected_model_benefit: Standard BMI categorization aligned with clinical risk strata.

features.name: age_bucket
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures nonlinear age-related risk progression with simple split points.

features.name: bp_abnormal_flag
features.description: Indicator that diastolic blood pressure is hypertensive (>=90) or implausibly low/missing (<=40).
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures abnormal BP regions in a single binary split.

features.name: missing_measurements_count
features.description: Count of physiological measurements recorded as zero (likely missing) among glucose, BP, skin, insulin, BMI.
features.expected_model_benefit: Signals data quality and may correlate with measurement context.

features.name: insulin_glucose_ratio
features.description: Ratio of serum insulin to plasma glucose, a proxy for insulin response efficiency.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines two related signals into a metabolic ratio that trees can split on.

features.name: bmi_age_interaction
features.description: Product of BMI and age capturing compounded metabolic risk with aging.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes nonlinear interaction between obesity and age for split-based models.

features.name: high_risk_composite_flag
features.description: Indicator combining elevated glucose (>=140), obesity (BMI>=30), and age>=35 simultaneously.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a single decisive split for clinically high-risk combinations.

features.name: pedigree_strength_bucket
features.expected_model_benefit: Discretizes hereditary risk into split-friendly bins.

features.name: pregnancy_intensity_per_age
features.description: Pregnancies normalized by reproductive years (age minus 15), capturing parity intensity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adjusts pregnancy count by exposure window for fairer comparison across ages.

features.name: metabolic_syndrome_judgment
features.description: Semantic ordinal score of metabolic syndrome plausibility from row values: 0=insufficient data (multiple zeros), 1=low (most markers normal), 2=moderate (one or two markers elevated among glucose, BMI, BP), 3=high (three or more markers elevated). Evaluated by inspecting whether plas, mass, pres, and insu jointly indicate metabolic dysregulation, not via formula.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic clinical-judgment summary that complements raw threshold features.
